summary: Bug fix verification for 4 reported issues: Mudras (unique images), Heart Practices (no black screen), Courses (3 Sacred Rites), Sacred Circle (5 community posts). All 18 backend tests passed. All 4 UI flows verified via Playwright. Core fixes working, but 1 UX issue found in Heart Practices guided mode.

ui_bugs.issue: When 'Begin Guided Heart Practice' is clicked, the guided mode shows only the practice name and a 'When complete, press button below' message — NO actual step-by-step instructions shown for 7 out of 10 practices. Root cause: HeartPractices.jsx only reads `selectedPractice.steps`, but most heart practice DB records use `ceremony_steps`, `meditation_steps`, `journey_steps`, `ritual_steps`, or `visualization_steps` — not `steps`. Only 3 practices (Meridian Therapy Flow, Trauma-Informed Somatic Shedding, Shamanic Healing Journey) use `steps`. The original 'black screen' crash bug is fixed — no crash occurs — but the guided mode shows near-empty content for most practices.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: In HeartPractices.jsx guided mode, also read ceremony_steps, meditation_steps, journey_steps, ritual_steps, visualization_steps — OR normalise all practices in the DB to use `steps` field. Example fix in JSX: const steps = selectedPractice.steps || selectedPractice.ceremony_steps || selectedPractice.meditation_steps || selectedPractice.journey_steps || selectedPractice.ritual_steps || selectedPractice.visualization_steps || [];

action_items: Fix HeartPractices.jsx to read alternate step field names (ceremony_steps, meditation_steps, journey_steps, etc.) — guided mode is currently near-empty for 7/10 practices despite having step data in DB
